notes.title: Knightblade Now Available on Mobile
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

After a long process and much debugging, I am happy to announce that Knightblade has finally been ported to Android! It has been a lengthy process, but Knightblade is now live and ready to download from Google Play. I honestly feel as a developer, that making a game ad-free and in-app purchase-free is the only way to go. I purposely made sure this is a one-time purchase, with no distracting ads or unnecessary additions. Instead this is an exact port of the PC game, with some minor changes. The audio quality will be lower to fit the compression I needed for the smaller game size, the movie theater has been removed, and the biggest change is that the enemies have been replaced. Knightblade Mobile will feature different enemy art, static instead of animated, and a different style to accommodate the platform change. The price will be slightly lower than the PC version, because of these changes. Other than that it's the same PC version! 

You can [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.rpgmaker.only]download Knightblade here on Google Play now[/url]! iOS support is unlikely, because of it's requirements that Apple forces on smaller developers like myself. Hope you enjoy taking Knightblade on the go!

-Nick

notes.title: Knightblade 1.4.1 Update Released
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

Just a small update today. A new shield has been added to the island shop, and a bug fix has been implemented. For some, a low memory issue could cause the Battle Results screen to lag or even crash the game, especially when escaping. I have decided to remove that screen all together. notes.title: Knightblade 1.4.0 Update Released
notes.content:
Hey everyone, just a quick update! Bug fixes as usual, but also something pretty noticeable. A new popup when you pick up an item! This is pretty big as anyone who has farmed or mined in Knightblade will be aware of the very annoying scrolling text that passed by when you picked up something. I'm happy to say that the scrolling text is gone. Replacing it is a slick popup over the player's head with an icon and text showing what you have picked up. This makes farming SO much quicker, and also more fun! I believe I removed the scrolling text from every item pickup in the game, but if you notice it anyone else please report it. Maybe this will open the door for more crops and a bigger farm in the future? If you'd like that let me know!

More to come!

-Nick

notes.title: Knightblade 1.3.0 "Spookiville" Update Released
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

A new update has been released! This one is substantial. There are some bug fixes, a few graphical changes, and new icons for the fishing gear.. but the big update is a new town! Welcome to Spookiville, the town where it's autumn year round. The new town features the Grand Wizard, where players can learn new spells. Spookiville also features a cinema, and some fun houses to play around in. More serious quests will eventually be added here, so far now some of the doors in town will be locked. I'm really pleased with how the tileset came out, since the town is really giving off those Halloween-time vibes I was aiming for. You'll be able to access the town the traditional way via the world map, but only if you have completed the story. If you haven't completed it, there's actually a fun way to access it: via a teleporter. You'll see the teleport device on the map near Mirage. Touch it to activate it. You'll need to do this to also start the mini quest that introduces you to the Grand Wizard. Have fun!

More updates on the way.

-Nick

notes.title: Knightblade Now Available - Upcoming DLC Announcement
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Today is an exciting day. After a year in development, and a successful Kickstarter campaign.. Knightblade has now been released to the public! But the work doesn't stop there. I hope everyone who plays Knightblade enjoys the game. If you are a backer and have already finished the game, there's reason to get excited about the future. As I have reiterated over and over, Knightblade is a low cost base game with free lifelong DLC coming in the future. And now that the game is public, I'm ready to announce two big pieces of the expansion I have planned for the game!

[b][h1]Knightblade: Underwater Kingdom -  DLC Expansion[/h1][/b]
[i][h2]Coming Summer 2022[/h2][/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42121911/682b15ab1b9a73468d589239441b30827f89b1fe.png[/img]

Knightblade: Underwater Kingdom is the first expansion to the base game. After completing the story in the first chapter, our hero now finds themselves taking a journey to a new destination for some relaxation. But they quickly discover that another darkness lurks in the world.. this time from under the sea. And once again, the Knightblade is the key to it all.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42121911/89ebe58ec1170470d2024c132e032c9e9a9413d6.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42121911/75feff6bc782d8943fd75fbc9ca1891bf4225b1d.png[/img][/url] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42121911/f616b17efab8b067efb08589b8217bd806ab4a4e.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42121911/6fb3480f6ecf2b271a13005bfd0ca528dc843c26.png[/img][/url]

Explore an underwater world, filled with new locations and deadly sea monsters. Talk to the locals who inhabit this magical world under the sea. Clear dungeons, discover secrets, and meet the God of the Sea himself. This is Knightblade: Underwater Kingdom. Coming as a free update to Knightblade later this year.

[b][h1]Knightblade: Quality of Life DLC[/h1][/b]
[i][h2]Coming Late 2022[/h2][/i]

So you've gotten married. You've become a true hero. Now what? With the upcoming Quality of Life DLC, new features after marriage will be added. How about adopting a child? Purchasing a new vacation home? New ideas and concepts will be added to expand life outside of monster battling and the main stories. Coming as a free update to Knightblade later this year.


I'll be announcing more updates as time rolls on. And the base game will continue to be improved and expanded, with frequent updates and bug fixes as they are reported.

I hope everyone enjoys the game, and I look forward to working on Underwater Kingdom!

-Nick

notes.title: Knightblade Version 1.2.0 "Day One Patch" Released
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

Ahead of the public release on April 4th, the "Day One Patch" is here! This update lays the groundwork for future expansion packs/DLC. In fact the first DLC announcement is coming in a couple days! It's going to be a big preview of what is to come to Knightblade later this year. But for now, we have this current update. Version 1.2.0 introduces a new icon set that adds life and color to the items you'll pick up in the world. Each weapon now has it's own unique design, and food is colorful and bright. Speaking of which, the new designs have allowed me to add more items to the game. From food to clothing. There are now fruit vendors selling the new selections. You can now buy more armor options, including female centered clothing. There's now an apple tree outside your farm, growing a new selection of crops that you can sell. The emotion bubbles during story events have also been updated with a new retro look. A few cosmetic changes here and there round out the update, with a technical update for the casino. It's now much easier to win Gems during the card game, allowing you a better chance at finding love. Bugs have also been patched out in this update as well.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42121911/bdd39bccfc6378202eef39b7df63b64feac8676b.png[/img]

I hope everyone enjoys the new colorful items, as we gear up for launch day! More to come, including the big DLC announcement!

Stay tuned.

-Nick

notes.title: Cloud Saves Now Supported
notes.content:
After hours of testing, I'm happy to announce that Knightblade now supports cloud saves! This is important because not only are your saves backed up in case of a crash or other problems, but also because you can now play across different devices. I tested it myself by playing Knightblade on my PC one minute, and then continuing my game on a Windows tablet.

More to come!

notes.title: Knightblade Version 1.1.1 Now Live
notes.content: Version 1.1.1 fixes many bugs reported by players. It also changes how items in your inventory are displayed in the shop screen allowing for a much quicker and more fluid way to sell items by removing categories. The sound option in the options menu has been redesigned as one slider for one master volume control. A new sound effect replaces that annoying "beep" that used to play when accepting a prompt. Weapons and armor have been updated to show their correct quantity in your inventory more accurately. Lastly, a new version number text has been added to the title screen. This will allow you to check and see which version of Knightblade you are running, so you can make sure you have the latest version. More to come!
